chapters.label: The header, live
chapters.text: Berlin, 2006, the World Cup final. In extra time, Zinedine Zidane passes to Willy Sagnol, who crosses it back. Zidane heads it hard!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Gianluigi Buffon stays set, on his toes. He watches the ball, springs up, and tips it over the bar!

chapters.label: From the front
chapters.text: From the front: one strong hand pushes the ball up and over. Italy went on to win the World Cup!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: stay set, watch the header, and use a strong hand to push it over the bar.
